axes.model_access: Model family disclosed on the official release line: Kling 4.0 officially launched 2026-10-15 (confirmed by the Kuaishou investor-relations press release 2026-10-16: up to 30 seconds per native generation, universal reference up to 15 materials/10 keyframes, up to 10-bit HDR, 8000-token prompt input); Kling 4.0 Flash opened first for high-frequency scenarios (late-2026-09 closed-beta framing).
axes.runtime: Three lines: web / app / API; generation processed in the cloud; plus a Team Space.
axes.local_files: Supports image/video/subject/audio multimodal reference input (the 4.0 universal-reference framing is in the official press release); the processing stance for uploaded content is in the permissions axis.
axes.background: Generation is task-based: submitted tasks queue in the cloud and outputs enter the account asset library; no official statement of a "keep-running-after-shutdown" form — tasks run in the cloud, independent of your machine being online.
axes.tools: The API line targets enterprises and developers (the 4.0 release framing says the API will open); in-platform community mechanics like Recreate/download (ToS §4.8); aggregated and called by third-party platforms (e.g. Runway MCP listed Kling 3.0/O3, see the Runway changelog 2026-09-18).
axes.context: Generation is task-based, no cross-session conversation-memory form; creative continuity relies on the asset library and reference inputs (4.0's universal reference of up to 15 materials is an in-request capability, not session memory).
axes.permissions: Official international ToS (effective 2026-04-21) §4.7.3(f): the platform may process content to "create, test, improve, train" its models; §4.7.4 opt-out goes through email support@kling.ai (revocation is prospective, not retroactive over completed training). §4.8: content published to the community can be Recreated/downloaded by other users.
axes.fit: People who weight image-to-video quality and the Chinese ecosystem. Commercial use must first pass the membership line (see the license column); publishing to the community equals going public; the training opt-out is an email request and prospective only.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. Video generation does not fit the coding test protocol; capability claims follow the official press releases and product pages.
unknowns:
- Membership commercial terms details in the Terms of Paid Service (the page loads its text dynamically; the body could not be fetched on 2026-10-20, this site does not restate them)
- The API line's current opening scope and pricing (the 4.0 press release says it will open; this site has not verified the landing status)
